	I am sorry JONL, but your latest fix to whatever had
no effect whatsoever to the string bug; it happens at exactly
the same place as before.  If you take a look at str:gcmarray
after doing:

	NILE$$^S
	NILAID^K

had a word bitten out of them (and replaced by zeros).  IT
IS ALWAYS THE SAME ONE (at least the first one, which
always shows up).  I and DCP ahve tried for hours trying
to find this bug and couldn't -- blech!

	-- Richard
